lines.text: Welcome to the NetOps Status dashboard. Here we monitor core network infrastructure in real time.
In the device table, we read the live telemetry for each host, including its IP address, network role, status, and latency.
Next, we trigger an on-demand health check to verify reachability across every IP endpoint.
The check completes immediately. We read the summary report below to confirm overall status and per-device diagnostics.
